It was the Monado.[XENO:n ]
It was...controlling me...[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Even so... It saved us...saved our future...[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Next...it will be up to you...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Well, I'd better get the supplies[XENO:n ]
delivered to the Defence Force.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]
I'll drop round the HQ and see how they're getting on.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I'll see you later.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Shulk. You're spending too much time in the lab.[XENO:n ]
Either that or rummaging for junk in the scrap yard.[XENO:n ]
It ain't healthy for a kid your age.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

That's why you're always looking so pasty.[XENO:n ]
You should get out, get some fresh air once in a while.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]
[XENO:act act=EVT5 ]All right, I'm off.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
